text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Wednesday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Seven laureates of national arts and culture prizes were nominated on Tuesday.
- The new government was sworn after its programme was approved by lawmakers.

- Consumers owed 140.6 million litas (80.5 million litas for heating and 60.1 million litas for electric energy) to Lietuvos Energija at the beginning of December. The debt increased by five percent since last month.
- Belarus company Belaruskalij intends to export fertilisers via Klaipeda port.
- The assets of the eleven operating banks in the country grew by 41 percent from 3.51 billion to 4.96 billion litas during the last three years.

- The size of the population and the average life expectancy have decreased during the last four years and scientists forecast this tendency to last. Lithuanians consume 27 litres of vodka per head per year.
- Parliament decided yesterday to carry out an international audit of the social security and pensions fund, SODRA.
